idea.title: Printable digital planners on Etsy at $9

source.text: Selling printable digital planners on Etsy at $9 each. Launch country US, budget $300, 8 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug etsy-planners.

idea.solution: Printable / digital planner files (PDF) sold as instant downloads on Etsy
assumptions: Customer assumed to be US Etsy shoppers buying generic planners (no niche stated)
Planners designed by the founder in a free tool such as Canva; no design track record
No questions asked: the user said 'just go'
Organic Etsy search is the main channel; Etsy Ads used only if they pay back

gross_margin.note: Etsy fees take $1.31 of $9 (85% margin); an Offsite Ads sale drops it to 70%

ltv_cac.note: Etsy Ads CAC ~$12 vs ~$9.2 LTV (0.77); only path to fix is unpaid organic search and Pinterest

pricing_power.note: $9 sits above the $7.99 median; $0.99 listings and PLR bundles anchor prices low

build_effort.note: A planner can be made in Canva and listed within days; tutorials abound

skills_match.note: No design track record; template design and Etsy SEO are learnable

capital_needed.note: $0.20 listings and a $15 setup fee fit the $300 budget with room

time_to_mvp.note: First listings live in 1-2 weeks at 8 h/week

channel_readiness.note: No audience; new shop competes with 866k listings in Etsy search (R5: no_distribution)

search_demand.note: 22,200 Etsy searches/month for 'digital planners'; r/GoodNotes ~110k members

trend.note: Category grows ~8%/yr per a vendor report, but Etsy active buyers only +1% YoY

willingness_to_pay.note: Buyers pay, but niche medians are $4.99-$7.97 and free 2026 PDFs exist

free_alternatives.note: Free 2026 planner PDFs (Passion Planner, Gumroad) do the job (R1)

competitor_density.note: 866k listings; 'ADHD planner' listings grew 13% in 30 days

differentiation.note: No edge stated; 7,500-page PLR bundles let anyone clone a catalog (R3)

legal_regulatory.note: Creativity Standards: own designs only, AI disclosure, no resold PLR; tax collected by Etsy

platform_dependency.note: One platform; a planner shop lost ~90% of Etsy sales in 2021 and shut in 2025

market_risk.note: Recurring yearly need, but sharp Dec-Jan seasonality; Etsy de-weighting digital items

skills.note: No stated design, Etsy SEO or Pinterest experience

assets.note: No audience, list, data or network

interest.note: Stated goal is side income, no domain passion

tam.reasoning: Global digital planners category, 2025 (vendor report; WiseGuy gives $3.42B for planner apps, another definition)

sam.reasoning: TAM $1.27B x 35% US share (assumption) x 10% sold via Etsy (assumption)

som.reasoning: Bottom-up: 15 sales/month (new-shop base case) x 12 x $9; top-down 0.1% of SAM ($44k) exceeds what top shops sell

demand_trend.value: flat, seasonal: 40,500 searches Dec-Jan vs 14,800 in spring

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: 6.5% transaction ($0.585) + 3% + $0.25 processing ($0.52) + $0.20 listing renewal = $1.31; Offsite Ads adds 15% ($1.35)

expected_lifetime.reasoning: One-off yearly product; assume 1 in 5 buyers buys a second item

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: Midpoint of vendor benchmark 1.5-4% for digital bundles (InsightAgent); vendor data conflicts

payback_months.reasoning: One-off: gross profit $7.69 per order < CAC $12, so a paid customer never pays back

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: 20 listings x $0.20 renewal every 4 months = $1/month; Canva free plan; one-off $15 setup fee

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $1 fixed / $7.69 per order; a $500/month side income needs 65 sales/month

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 2 weeks to list 5-10 planners + 2-6 weeks for organic Etsy search to index a new shop

type_checks.note: Organic order nets $7.69 (85%); an Etsy Ads order at ~$12 CAC loses ~$4.30, an Offsite Ads order nets $6.34
No shipping; digital downloads are typically set non-returnable, though faulty files must be refunded by the seller

rules_applied.effect: total 57 capped at 49: LTV:CAC 0.77 and no channel

confidence.note: Etsy pages returned 403, so shop sales counts and fee rates come from search snippets and fee guides; real CPC and conversion data would raise it

verdict.cheapest_test: List 3 planners for one narrow niche with 0 ad spend, pin 15 Pins, and count views, favorites and sales over 7 days
kill_criteria: Fewer than 300 total listing views by day 7 -> stop adding listings
0 sales from 10 listings by day 30 -> archive it
Fewer than 10 sales/month by day 90 -> archive it
Etsy Ads CAC above $7.70 after $30 spend -> turn ads off

rescue.change: One narrow niche (e.g. a planner for one profession) priced $12-15, with a Pinterest channel built before listing
rescue.why: Lifts differentiation, pricing_power and channel_readiness; organic CAC clears no_distribution and R6
rescue.requires: A niche with fewer than 5,000 listings, 30+ Pins a month for 3 months

rescue.change: Sell custom, personalised planners (names, dates, layouts on request) at $25-40 instead of generic files
rescue.why: Escapes the $0.99 PLR price anchor and the free_alternative; clone-proof because each is made to order
rescue.requires: Design skill and 1-2 hours of work per order, which caps income at 8 h/week

narrative.answer: NO-GO. A generic $9 planner with no edge enters **866,355 listings**, competes with free 2026 PDFs and PLR clones, and paid ads cost about **$12 per $7.70 sale**. Only a narrow niche with its own Pinterest channel reaches PIVOT range.
tldr: Supply swamps demand: **866,355** Etsy listings for 22,200 monthly searches.
Etsy Ads lose money: **$12 CAC** against $7.70 net per sale.
Free PDFs and **$0.99** PLR clones set the price anchor below $9.

key_findings.title: 866,355 listings for 22,200 searches
key_findings.detail: About **0.026 searches per listing per month** for 'digital planners' on Etsy; a new shop with no reviews starts at the back.

key_findings.title: Paid ads lose money on every sale
key_findings.detail: $0.30 CPC / 2.5% conversion = **$12 CAC** vs $7.70 net per $9 order (estimate from vendor benchmarks).

key_findings.title: Free and PLR planners anchor price low
key_findings.detail: Free 2026 PDFs exist and 7,500-page PLR bundles sell for a few dollars; median price is **$7.99**, below your $9.

narrative.steelman: Etsy hands you **88M buyers**, unit cost is near zero (85% margin) and $300 plus 8 h/week is a cheap bet; top shops sold 50,000+ copies. True, but those shops started in 2016-2020, before 866k listings and the AI/PLR flood.
narrative.recommendation: Do not launch a generic $9 planner shop. If you want this category, run the 7-day niche test with $0 ad spend and archive it if it misses the numbers.

premortem.cause: New listings stay buried under 866k competing planners and never get traffic
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 50 views per listing in the first 30 days

premortem.cause: Etsy Ads spend more per sale than the $7.70 each sale nets
premortem.early_signal: Ad cost per order above $7.70 after the first $30 of spend

premortem.cause: AI and PLR clones at $0.99-$3 undercut the $9 price
premortem.early_signal: Page-1 results for your keyword priced under $3 and 0 sales after 300 views

changes.what: Etsy says it is better managing the prominence of physical versus digital items in search
'ADHD planner' listings grew from 69,446 to 78,752 in 30 days
Sellers report AI-generated listings flooding Etsy and cutting sales
Creativity Standards updated for digital items (own design, AI disclosure)
PLR bundles of 7,500+ editable planner pages sold to new sellers

why_now.note: Every recent change adds supply or lowers digital visibility; the window closed for generic planners.

icp.who: US iPad/GoodNotes users and printable-planner buyers (students, parents, ADHD planners) shopping for next year's planner
icp.pays_for_today: Etsy planners at $1.99-$39.94, median $7.99 (RankHero, 2026-10), or free PDFs
icp.budget: Under $10 for most; 67% of GoodNotes listings are priced under $10
icp.trigger: New year: searches peak at 40,500/month in Dec-Jan; back to school

customer.segment: US Etsy buyers of digital or printable planners
customer.pain: Want an organised, good-looking planner for the new year
customer.today: Buy a $2-$10 Etsy planner, use a free PDF, or a GoodNotes/Notion template

free_alternative.evidence: Passion Planner gives away a weekly 2026 PDF and Uplifting Planner a free hyperlinked 2026 GoodNotes planner.

strong_competitor.evidence: DashPlanner (54,890 sales), THISS Planner (53,718) and PinkPunchStudio (50,594) dominate; traction from sales counts, review counts unknown.

graveyard.evidence: Outline Planner lost ~90% of Etsy sales in April 2021 (~$4k to ~$500/month) and shut down in 2025.

no_distribution.evidence: No audience; Etsy search gives 0.026 searches per listing per month and Etsy Ads CAC (~$12) exceeds the $7.70 net per sale.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Clear: Etsy fees take $1.31 of $9 (85% margin), $2.66 with Offsite Ads (70%); only paid ads push it negative.

weak_demand.evidence: Clear: 22,200 Etsy searches/month, seasonal peak 40,500; category reports 4-8% CAGR. Demand exists, supply is the problem.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: Single-platform business; Etsy is de-weighting digital items (Q3 2026) and suspends shops for Creativity Standards breaches.

saturated_wave.evidence: 'ADHD planner' alone added 9,306 effective listings in 30 days; PLR bundles and 'make $1,000 with ChatGPT planners' videos feed the wave.

competitors.name: PlannedSplendor
competitors.traction_note: 17,257 sales since 2023: late entrant that still won
competitors.gap: Shows a 2023 entry can work, with a strong design brand

competitors.name: Passion Planner free weekly 2026 PDF
competitors.gap: Free in exchange for an email

competitors.name: PLR planner bundles (7,500+ pages)
competitors.gap: Lets any seller clone a full catalog

use_cases.name: Niche planner for one profession or condition
use_cases.who_pays: A narrow segment searching a long-tail keyword

scenarios.name: Pessimistic
scenarios.note: Listings never surface; common outcome for new shops

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.note: 15 x $7.69 net = ~$115 profit; $20 of costs is listing renewals plus light ads (estimate)

scenarios.name: Optimistic
scenarios.note: 65 sales needed for $500/month net; requires a ranking niche or a Pinterest channel

risks.risk: Etsy search de-weights digital items or changes ranking
risks.mitigation: Build a Pinterest and email channel you own

risks.risk: Shop suspended for Creativity Standards (PLR or undisclosed AI)
risks.mitigation: Only original designs; disclose AI use

risks.risk: Designs copied and resold in bundles
risks.mitigation: File DMCA takedowns; keep shipping new designs

risks.risk: Seasonal cliff: demand falls ~60% after January
risks.mitigation: Launch before mid-December or wait for August

test_plan.step: Pick one niche keyword with under 5,000 listings and 500+ monthly searches
test_plan.verify: 1 keyword meeting both numbers in RankHero/eRank

test_plan.step: Design 3 planners for that niche in Canva (original, no PLR)
List them on Etsy with $0 ads ($0.60 in listing fees)
Publish 15 Pins linking to the listings

test_plan.verify: 300+ listing views and 10+ favorites, or stop

rescue.change: One narrow niche (e.g. a planner for one profession) priced $12-15, with a Pinterest channel built before listing
rescue.why: Lifts differentiation, pricing_power and channel_readiness; organic CAC clears no_distribution and R6
rescue.requires: A niche with fewer than 5,000 listings, 30+ Pins a month for 3 months

rescue.change: Sell custom, personalised planners (names, dates, layouts on request) at $25-40 instead of generic files
rescue.why: Escapes the $0.99 PLR price anchor and the free_alternative; clone-proof because each is made to order
rescue.requires: Design skill and 1-2 hours of work per order, which caps income at 8 h/week

narrative.lesson: Low barriers to entry mean high competition: when anyone can list in a day, distribution is the product.
